name: Prompt Library
summary: Slash prompts for everyday requests: /review, /explain, /tests, /commit and /fix, each with a template you can change.

prompts.name: review
prompts.description: Review the uncommitted changes, optionally with a focus

prompts.name: explain
prompts.description: Explain code, a file or a topic in this repository

prompts.name: tests
prompts.description: Write tests for the given code or behavior

prompts.name: commit
prompts.description: Draft a commit message for the staged changes

prompts.name: fix
prompts.description: Find the root cause of a problem and fix it
